assertion.text: Erdős Problem #114 [status: falsifiable; formalized: no]. If $p(z)\in\mathbb{C}[z]$ is a monic polynomial of degree $n$ then is the length of the curve $\{ z\in \mathbb{C} : \lvert p(z)\rvert=1\}$ maximised when $p(z)=z^n-1$? Current best: {/UL}  Erd\H{o}s, Herzog, and Piranian \cite{EHP58} also ask whether the length is at least $2\pi$ if $\{ z: \lvert f(z)\rvert<1\}$ is connected (which $z^n$ shows is the best possible). Prize: $250. Tags: analysis, polynomials.
